failure: Failure: An identified glutamate radical, measured isotope-dependent reaction kinetics, and measured return-versus-destruction probabilities are missing. Separate published abundance and bulk-nitrogen measurements concern different aliquots, so the source's inventory comparison is a warning under a restrictive model, not an empirical refutation. The calculation is not evidence the reaction occurs in Bennu.
interface: Interface: The Hamiltonian, initial singlet state, single nuclear coupling, zero field, reaction rates, returned-molecule handedness rule and destruction channel are imposed assumptions. Other nuclear couplings, exchange, relaxation, additional reactions, open-system reservoirs and the actual Bennu reaction path are not specified by evidence.

claims.title: A restricted nitrogen radical-pair model bounds isotope-selective singlet yield
